descricao: Use the mobile app to record collections, diaries, reminders and evidence during expeditions, even offline.

instrucoes.passo1: Tap "Download app" on your Android phone to download the installer.
instrucoes.passo2: When opening the file, allow installing apps from unknown sources if Android asks.
instrucoes.passo3: Open the app and sign in with the same email and password you use on the panel.
